ablation.name: phase4c_dino_clean_lvl2
ablation.notes: Phase 4C.0 CONTROL: real DINO cache (clean, no RGB mask) + 2-Level DWT lowpass. Isolates the effect of using real DINO patches (vs learnable style_memory). baseline 4D.1 used style_memory (dino_cache_path=''); this config uses real DINO cache to measure the delta.
